results.title: Trust and Satisfaction, Two Stepping Stones for Successful E ...
results.content: Trust and satisfaction are essential ingredients for successful business relationships in business-to-consumer electronic commerce. Drawing on three primary bodies of literature, the theory of reasoned action, the extended valence framework, and expectation-confirmation theory, this study synthesizes a model of consumer trust and satisfaction in the context of e-commerce. The results indicate that trust directly and indirectly affects a consumer's purchase decision in combination with perceived risk and perceived benefit, and also that trust has a longer term impact on consumer e-loyalty through satisfaction.
